content.title: World Baseball Classic: MLB's Grip Is Too Tight on the Tournament - Bloomberg
content.text: OpinionAdam Minter, ColumnistMarch 13, 2026 at 6:00 AM CDTBy Adam MinterAdam Minter is a Bloomberg Opinion columnist covering the business of sports. He is the author, most recently, of “Secondhand: Travels in the New Global Garage Sale." FacebookXLinkedInEmailLinkGiftExpandThe MLB can’t always be the home to run to. At its finest, as in Tuesday’s shocking upset of the US team by Italy, the games generate the kind of electricity fans feel at the FIFA World Cup.That’s exactly how Major League Baseball, which owns the WBC, wants it. The tournament, first played in 2006, was designed to boost the league’s profile beyond North America and help it become a global game.
